build_LocallyLinearEmbedding_standard: run LocallyLinearEmbedding with method standard to embed S-curve data into 2D
build_Isomap: run Isomap with 12 neighbors and 2 components to embed S-curve data into 2D
build_MDS: run MDS with 2 components, 50 max iterations and classical init to preserve original distances
build_SpectralEmbedding: run SpectralEmbedding with 2 components and 12 neighbors using Laplacian eigenmaps
build_TSNE: run TSNE with perplexity 30, 250 iterations and random init to minimize KL divergence
